context: 5 Conclusion The performance of our data structure is asymptotically optimal when compared with static point location linear decision trees. It is an open problem to obtain optimal performance when compared with linear decision trees that may reorganize themselves. This open problem may be difficult as it is related to the dynamic optimality conjecture by Sleator and Tarjan [17], which conjectures that the performance of a splay tree is no more than O(n) plus a constant times the time required by any binary search tree algorithm. The dynamic optimality conjecture is still open after over thirty years.
